Buy from **Ottervale Audio** — the second listing (`/b`).

The two listings are otherwise identical:

| **Shipping** | Free, 3-5 business days | Free, 3-5 business days |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| **Specs / Colour / In box** | Identical | Identical |
| **Returns** | **30-day, buyer pays return shipping** | **Free 90-day returns** |

**Why:** For the same headphones at the same price with the same shipping and warranty, Ottervale gives you three times as long to return them, and returns are free instead of at your cost. There's no advantage to Brackmoor to offset that, so Ottervale is the lower-risk choice.
